works.title: Open-Source News Verification Platform
works.description: A separate public-domain, open-source website focused on algorithmically-verified factual news aggregation and distribution. Maintains journalistic integrity through automated fact-checking, source verification, and elimination of clickbait. Designed to serve as a genuine public service by breaking the scoop-driven news cycle.
works.quote: I would just keep a completely separate newsfeed for this one purpose

works.title: Programming in Natural Language
works.description: A guide documenting how to use natural language prompting and AI tools for software development, bridging the gap between domain experts and professional programmers. Intended to democratize coding by showing how to translate expertise into working code through AI collaboration.
works.quote: is going to be a book on programming in natural language—that's what will bridge the gap between people with domain expertise
